['Select distinct compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism', "Join molecule_dictionary as parent on parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'", 'Join molecule_hierarchy mh on mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno', 'Join molecule_dictionary as child on child.molregno = mh.molregno', 'Join compound_records as r on r.molregno = child.molregno', 'Join docs on r.doc_id = docs.doc_id', 'Join activities on r.record_id = activities.record_id', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary as t on activities.tid = t.tid', 'Join compound_structures as cs on cs.molregno = child.molregno', "Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.bao_endpoint = 'BAO_0000190' and activities.standard_units = 'nM' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.standard_value is not null and activities.standard_value > 0 and activities.standard_value < 100000 and t.pref_name = 'Vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2'", 'Return compound_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles, r.compound_key as compound_key, coalesce(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi) as pubmed_id_or_doi, assays.description as assay_description, activities.standard_type as standard_type, activities.standard_relation as standard_relation, activities.standard_value as standard_value, activities.standard_units as standard_units, activities.activity_comment as activity_comment, t.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, t.pref_name as target_name, t.organism as target_organism', 'Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism']
